children: Portuguese consumer prices rose 3.3% year-on-year in August, up from 3% in the previous month, preliminary data from the National Statistics Institute (INE) showed on Monday.
Core inflation, which strips out volatile food and energy prices and is seen as a better gauge of the underlying trend, came in at 2.7% year-on-year, slightly up from 2.6% in July.
On a monthly basis, the INE said that overall consumer prices rose 0.1% this month after a 0.5% fall in July.
